items.feature: Sidebar entry that returns to Home, plus a keyboard command to go Home
items.why: Sidebar Home button works (src/components/Sidebar.tsx); no go-to-Home shortcut is wired (keybinding registry declares commands only).

items.feature: Workspaces listed under their repository, repositories as collapsible groups
items.why: Repos render as collapsible groups with nested workspace rows (Sidebar.tsx, store toggleRepo).

items.feature: Manual, persisted ordering of repositories
items.why: No ordering UI or logic; display_order exists only in crates/openconductor-db/migrations/0001_core.sql, which the app does not depend on.

items.feature: Hide and unhide a repository, with a toggle to show hidden ones
items.why: No hide/unhide; hidden column exists only in the unwired DB crate schema.

items.feature: Per-repository icon (icon, emoji, favicon or uploaded image) next to the repo name
items.why: No repository icon support.

items.feature: Add-repository control reachable from the sidebar
items.why: Sidebar '+' opens the Open-project dialog, which only appends to localStorage; it does not call the registered add_repository command.

items.feature: Workspace row shows the workspace name, distinguishing user-set from generated names
items.why: Row shows the name; no user-set vs generated distinction (user_set_* flags not modelled in the UI).

items.feature: Workspace branch visible from the sidebar row
items.why: Branch appears only in the row tooltip.

items.feature: Status indicator from a derived status with optional manual override (default in-progress)
items.why: Status dot uses our own idle/working/needs-review/archived model, not derived/manual status with in-progress default (src/state/types.ts).

items.feature: Line additions/deletions on each row, colored, with a setting to color unselected rows
items.why: +/- counts render from stored placeholder numbers; not computed from git, no colour setting.

items.feature: Unread marker, mark-as-unread action and jump-to-next-unread command
items.why: No unread state, action or command; column only in the unwired DB crate.

items.feature: Pin workspaces into a pinned group at the top
items.why: No pinning; pinned_at only in the unwired DB crate.

items.feature: User navigation sections: create, rename, delete, emoji; move a workspace into or out of a section
items.why: No sections UI or commands; navigation_sections only in crates/openconductor-db/migrations/0005_navigation_and_favorites.sql (unwired).

items.feature: Drag a workspace row onto a section
items.why: No drag and drop.

items.feature: Workspace numbers shown optionally, with Cmd+1..9 switching
items.why: No numbers or Cmd+1..9 handler; registry entries in src/keybindings are declarations without handlers.

items.feature: Next/previous workspace commands
items.why: Declared in the keybinding registry only; no handler.

items.feature: Search/filter workspaces
items.why: No workspace search.

items.feature: Rename a workspace (local only), optionally also renaming the branch
items.why: No user rename. src/workspace/naming.ts plans the automatic first-message rename only, and is not imported by the UI.

items.feature: Archive with confirmation, refusing while a git operation is in progress, recording an archive commit
items.why: UI archive (WorkspaceView) deletes the localStorage row without confirmation or busy check. Backend WorkspaceManager::archive has the busy guard and archive commit but is not a registered command.

items.feature: Browse archived workspaces and unarchive one
items.why: WorkspaceManager::restore exists (src-tauri/src/workspace/mod.rs); no command, no UI.

items.feature: Resizable sidebar and show/hide toggles for left and right sidebars
items.why: Toggle works via Cmd+B and '[' (src/state/shortcuts.ts, App.tsx); the sidebar is a fixed 248px column with no resize.

items.feature: Optional CPU/memory usage readout in the sidebar footer
items.why: Footer shows app name/version only.

items.feature: Sidebar transparency (vibrancy) setting
items.why: No vibrancy/transparency.

items.feature: Workspace actions menu on a row (copy info, rename, archive, pin, section)
items.why: No row context menu or actions menu.

items.feature: Empty state when there are no repositories or workspaces
items.why: Muted single-line empty state matches evidence/screens/home.md.

items.feature: Sidebar add menu offering the three Home actions plus recent local repositories not yet added (spinner while loading)
items.why: '+' opens a dialog directly; no three-action menu, no recents.

items.feature: Left sidebar visibility and width persisted as settings (default visible, width 256)
items.why: Visibility persists inside the localStorage app state, not as a setting; width is fixed (248px vs evidence default 256).

items.feature: Home is the root route and the default screen
items.why: Home is the default screen, but there is no router or '/' route (selection state in src/state/store.ts).

items.feature: Home renders nothing while the organization loads and redirects a cloud organization to all-workspaces
items.why: No organization concept; no loading or cloud redirect state.

items.feature: Centered wordmark (light/dark variants) above three label-only entry cards in a 1-to-3 column grid, whole area a window drag region
items.why: Wordmark, three label-only cards, 1-to-3 column grid at 768px, drag region, fade-in and has-workspaces spacing (HomeScreen.tsx, styles.css) follow evidence/screens/home.md.

items.feature: When the left sidebar is hidden, Home shows a toggle button with its shortcut, offset past the traffic lights
items.why: Toggle shown only when the sidebar is hidden, with tooltip and shortcut hint (HomeScreen.tsx).

items.feature: Add an existing local repository via a folder picker, with default-branch detection
items.why: Dialog with folder picker adds to localStorage with defaultBranch hard-coded to main; backend add_repository (git toplevel) and default_branch detection exist but are not called.

items.feature: Open project: folder picker; no .git leads to an add dialog that offers git init; a missing origin (non-GitHub setting off) leads to the same dialog; otherwise add with a file:// remote; errors in a toast
items.why: Only the backend toplevel check exists (service.rs add_repository). No .git/init dialog, origin check, file:// remote or error toast.

items.feature: Clone a GitHub repository by URL into a chosen folder, with progress
items.why: Dialog parses GitHub URLs but performs no clone and has no destination picker or progress.

items.feature: Create a new project: local folder, git init, optional private GitHub repo, then a first workspace
items.why: Quick start dialog with placeholder templates; no git init, no GitHub repo, no first workspace on disk.

items.feature: Refuse adding a repository that is already added
items.why: Store silently ignores a duplicate path/remote; no already-exists message. Backend add_repository returns the existing id.

items.feature: Home explains that a repository must be added before creating a workspace
items.why: Sidebar empty line exists; creating a workspace with no repository is not reachable, and no Home explanation is shown.

items.feature: Home shows workspaces with their status (status matrix option, mine vs all)
items.why: Home shows no workspace list or statuses.

items.feature: Dashboard and all-workspaces routes
items.why: No /dashboard or /all-workspaces screens.

items.feature: Recent workspaces list
items.why: No recent workspaces.

items.feature: Search the repository list
items.why: No repository search.

items.feature: Clone dialog shows recent repositories with loading placeholders and a screen-reader status
items.why: Clone dialog has no recent repositories.

items.feature: First-run onboarding route before Home
items.why: No onboarding.

items.feature: Repositories and workspaces persist in SQLite (conductor.db shape), surviving restart
items.why: UI state lives in localStorage; backend keeps a TSV repo registry; the Conductor-shaped SQLite schema in crates/openconductor-db is not used by the app.

items.feature: Create-workspace action per repository (sidebar and Home)
items.why: Per-repo '+' instantly adds a localStorage row with an adjective-noun name; no dialog, no worktree.

items.feature: Full-screen create-workspace page with its own composer and tab navigation
items.why: No create page or composer.

items.feature: Create a workspace from a PR, branch or issue
items.why: src/workspace/createFlow.ts models PR/branch/issue sources with tests; not used by the UI.

items.feature: Choose the base branch new workspaces branch from; remember the intended target branch
items.why: create_workspace accepts a base branch and fetches origin/<base> first (mod.rs create); createFlow defaults it to the repo default branch; no UI.

items.feature: Branch picker with search, loading, empty and error states
items.why: list_branches command is registered; no picker UI.

items.feature: Each workspace is a git worktree on its own branch in a configurable workspaces directory
items.why: create_workspace runs git worktree add -b <branch> <data_dir>/workspaces/<slug>/<name> <base>; registered but never invoked by the UI.

items.feature: Branch name prefix setting (none, user-based or custom)
items.why: naming.ts resolveBranchPrefix and settings keys exist; no settings UI and not wired to creation from the UI.

items.feature: Generated placeholder name/branch, replaced when the agent names the branch (rename-on-branch setting)
items.why: City names with rarity tiers and first-message rename plan (naming.ts, tested); the UI still uses src/state/names.ts adjective-noun names.

items.feature: Validate workspace names and branch names before creating
items.why: validateWorkspaceName/validateBranchName (naming.ts) and git check-ref-format (git.rs valid_branch_name); no UI surfaces errors.

items.feature: Copy ignored files (worktreeinclude / include globs / .env*) into each new workspace
items.why: files_to_copy.rs resolves .worktreeinclude / globs / .env* and create() copies them; only reachable through the unwired command.

items.feature: Run the repository setup script on creation and keep its log
items.why: run_setup exists but create() does not call it and no log path is kept.

items.feature: Initializing state with progress while the workspace is created
items.why: createFlow.ts progress reducer (initializing -> setting_up -> ready/failed); no UI.

items.feature: Creation failure surfaced with logs; incomplete workspaces cleaned up on start
items.why: Failed state modelled in createFlow.ts; no failure UI and no startup cleanup of incomplete workspaces.

items.feature: Create a workspace directly inside a sidebar section
items.why: No sections.

items.feature: Draft the first agent message, then create the workspace and send it
items.why: createFlow.ts carries the first message in the create request; no composer and no session start on create.

items.feature: Assign a per-workspace number on creation
items.why: No workspace numbers (schema column only in the unwired DB crate).

items.feature: Optionally start the run script automatically after setup
items.why: crates/scripts parses a scripts.auto_run_after_setup setting, but nothing acts on it and that crate is not an app dependency; workspace::scripts::spawn_run is never called after setup.
